improvement: Outlier replacement by linear interpolation between non-outlier neighbors (despike_interp, k=4.5) instead of the channel median (k=5.0).
selection: interp fill at k=4.5 selected over median-replace at k=5.0 and interp at k=4.0/5.0/5.5/6.0 on the demo gate (7 configurations).

creative_tests_rejected.stream_adaptive_recentering: Recentering stream features toward training means using warmup/running stream statistics (label-free): -2 to -3 pp. The drift is not a uniform offset.
creative_tests_rejected.nan_mask_structure: Per-class channel NaN rates are flat in train (0.0054-0.0098); not class-informative.
creative_tests_rejected.consistent_despiked_training: Training on despiked features makes training and inference see identical preprocessing, but transfers worse: 78.75%/79.75% on demo vs 82.25% for the model trained on unclipped features. The mismatch acts as robustness regularization.
creative_tests_rejected.stronger_capacity: 400 iterations x 31 leaves on despiked features: demo 79.75%.
